title: Install Easy Workout
lead: Add it to your home screen and open it like an app.
leadComputer: Install it on your computer and open it in its own window.

step.shareSafariMeta: At the bottom or top of Safari. Not there? Tap <more/> first.
step.shareOtherMeta: In the address bar, or in the <more/> or <menu/> menu.
step.addHomeMeta: Scroll down the list if you can’t see it.
step.addMeta: If an Open as Web App switch shows up, leave it on.
step.open: Open Easy Workout from your home screen
step.openSetUpMeta: That’s where you set it up.
step.openSharedMeta: Your sessions and settings are already there.
step.tapInstall: Tap Install at the bottom of the screen
step.confirm: Confirm in the window that opens
step.confirmMeta: The app lands on your home screen.
step.menuMeta: At the top or bottom of the screen, depending on your browser.
step.installAppMeta: Or Add to Home screen, depending on the browser.
step.confirmComputerMeta: Easy Workout opens in its own window.
step.addressBarMeta: On the right of the address. Not there? Look for Install in the or menu.
step.fileMenu: In the menu bar, choose File, then Add to Dock

firefox.title: Firefox can’t install web apps
firefox.text: Easy Workout works here too, in a tab. To install it, open this page in Chrome, Edge or Safari.
firefox.data: Your data doesn’t move between browsers: export a backup to take it with you.

others.title: With another browser
others.ios: Chrome, Edge, Firefox: same steps, from their Share button.
others.safariMac: Safari on Mac: File, then Add to Dock.
others.firefox: Firefox: can’t install, keep it in a tab.

firstNote: Install first, then set up: what you set up in {{browser}} stays in {{browser}}.
setupStays: Your setup is in {{browser}} and won’t follow into the installed app. Export a backup, then restore it when you first open the app.

why.title: Why install it
why.dataMeta: Safari can clear a site’s data after 7 days without a visit. Not the installed app’s.
why.screenMeta: No browser bars during your workout.
why.windowMeta: No more hunting for the tab.
why.offlineMeta: It opens even without a connection.
why.home: One tap from your home screen
why.homeMeta: No more hunting for the tab.

done.title: App installed
done.text: Open it from your home screen.
done.textComputer: It opens in its own window. You’ll find it with your other apps.
